reportedIssues: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a localized, human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular near you'). This looks broken to users and undermines trust in the app.

Cards in the 'Fastest near you' row show only name and delivery fee, while cards in the popular section show rating, time, fee and cuisine. The inconsistent metadata density makes the first row feel incomplete and harder to compare.
